g.text: From confidence in the trigger at 13:37to full restoration at 17:06
Work focuses on rolling the Bot Management configuration file back to a last-known-good version;the file restore is the fastest of several parallel workstreams.
Creation and propagation of new Bot Management configuration files stopped, after identifying themodule as the source of the 500 errors.
Test of the new file complete: recovery observed using the old version of the configuration file,and the fix accelerated globally.
Main impact resolved. A correct Bot Management configuration file deployed globally and mostservices start operating correctly; downstream services observe reduced errors.
All services resolved. All downstream services restarted and all operations fully restored.
3 h 02 min from impact start to main resolution, and 5 h 38 min to full restoration — derived from the published timestamps.
Cloudflare, “Cloudflare outage on November 18, 2025”, incident timeline. Severity bands are this review’s reading of the published status column.
